decisive_items: remote history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (7 years prior) and bladder urothelial carcinoma (10 years prior)
Chest ultrasound revealed a soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device
response.rationale: Prior cancer history plus a new vascular soft-tissue mass at the pacemaker pocket, with infection and hematoma excluded, makes metastatic disease the most likely diagnosis; 'pacemaker pocket tumor' is a local description rather than the etiologic diagnosis.

rejected.why: Describes the local mass but is less etiologically specific than metastatic disease given the strong prior cancer history.
Infection was explicitly excluded in the vignette.
Hematoma was explicitly excluded in the vignette.
